title: Catalyst construction (Sufficiency Step 3) is invoked, not proved

comments.author: human
comments.body:
In the sufficiency proof (Section 3), `Step 3` and `Remark rem:honest` explicitly defer the catalyst construction to Klimesh (2007, §IV) / Turgut (2007). The geometric catalyst $c^{(m)}=Z_m^{-1}(\rho^0,\dots,\rho^{m-1})$ is introduced, but the central quantitative claim — that it verifies the ReLU/majorization test $\sum_k\max(w_k-s,0)\le\sum_k\max(w'_k-s,0)$ for all $s\ge0$ and all large $m$ — is asserted, not derived. The supporting Legendre/large-deviation relation $\log\sum_k\max(w_k-s,0)=\sup_{t>0}(t(-\log s)-\log P_t(w))+o(1)$ is stated without proof, and the claim that the $O(1/m)$ corrections are dominated by the uniform gap $\inf_{|t|\ge\eta}|G(t)|>0$ is hand-waved.

This is the analytic core of the Klimesh–Turgut theorem and is the actual mathematical content of the 'if' direction. Per the grounding/gap-free commandments, the proof must either (a) reproduce the quantitative estimate in full with explicit error bounds, or (b) cite a precisely-stated published theorem, verify each hypothesis in the current setting, and quote the matching conclusion. The current text does neither rigorously.
